Plan envelope: 36,879 m (X) × 36,716 m (Z); bounding circle Ø 41,032 m
Main dome Ø 15,200 m; collar Ø 16,720 m; satellites Ø 9,120 m domes at 15,500 m from centre
Main dome diameter 15.2 km. The show never states a size; the only in-universe yardstick is the S3E7 street-level material (cars ~4 m) which gives
tower widths and spacing, and extrapolating that to the exterior establishing shot puts the central pod at roughly the size of Brooklyn (15-17 km).
The community 1:200 000 print model reaches the same Brooklyn-sized centre disc independently.
Shape follows the written descriptions in research.md: one revolved main pod (glass dome, raised collar, bowl hull tapering into stacked metallic
plates), three 60 % copies of that pod protruding from it on organic bridges, three legs extruding downward, and a single central antenna running down
the middle of the main pod, shorter than the legs. No show frame could be viewed from this environment (see research.md), so plate count, leg rake and
bridge sag are the least certain values.
WRITTEN SOURCES (see research.md for full text)
Wiki: 'a massive space station with a central glass dome, with three separate, smaller domed districts protruding from it. Several metallic plates extend from the bottom'.
Build log: 'profile sketch of the main pod ... revolved'; 'raised piece that rests on the outside of the pod'; smaller pods 'scaled down to 60%'; bridge 'sculpted';
'three legs extruding downward'; 'the middle antenna that runs right down the middle of the center pod ... shorter than the surrounding feet'.
Print model: 'always the same shot at the same angle, so ... the lower part' is speculative; centre disc ~ Brooklyn.
S1E10 Rick: 'The citadel of Ricks. It's the secret headquarters for the council of Ricks.' Morty (S3E1): 'All the different Ricks from all the different realities got together to hide here.'
S3E1 Worker Rick: 'This area's for teleporting the entire Citadel to somewhere else using only buttons and dials.' Summer: 'A city of Grandpas?'
